title: Brun's theorem: the sum of the reciprocals of the twin primes converges, after Brun 1919, with the twin prime upper bound and every even gap
summary: A sorry-free Lean 4 proof of the theorem of V. Brun, La série 1/5 + 1/7 + 1/11 + 1/13 + ... où les dénominateurs sont nombres premiers jumeaux est convergente ou finie, Bull. Sci. Math. 43, 1919: the sum of the reciprocals of p and of p + 2 over the primes p with p + 2 prime converges. This is a sorry-free proof of a statement that lean-eval lists as a challenge, brun_constant_converges, proved here in the exact lean-eval form as well.
